name: Portkey
summary: Portkey is an AI gateway that puts 250+ models behind one API and adds logging, guardrails, caching and access controls. The core gateway is open source and can be self-hosted; a managed control plane adds observability and governance. Palo Alto Networks completed its acquisition of Portkey in May 2026 and is making it the AI gateway of Prisma AIRS.
facts: Portkey, part of Palo Alto Networks since May 2026
Free Developer tier (10k logs/month); Production $49/month; Enterprise custom
goodFor: Enterprises that need guardrails and audit logs
Self-hosting the gateway with an optional managed UI
watchOut: Product direction now set by Palo Alto Networks
Semantic caching and advanced guardrails are Enterprise-only
Free tier stops recording logs past 10k per month
